name: WLF_RECOMMENDATION_PROFILES
description: This table stores the details of the recommendation profiles.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: System-generated unique identifier1

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_PROFILE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number identifier for profile.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_TYPE
columns.description: Represents the type of recommendation , system generated or user created.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Specifies priority for the recommendation profile.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the recommendation profile.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Represnts the id of the urecommender.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Represnts the type of the recoemmender

columns.name: ATTRIBUTION_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Represents the lookup code for the recommender

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_COMMENTS
columns.description: Represnets the comments for recoomendation profile.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Represents the name of the recommendation profile

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Represents the description of the recommendation profile

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the source type of the recommendation profile

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Represent the source id of the recommendation profile

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE
columns.description: Represents recommendation expansion One-time or Ongoing

columns.name: SCHEDULE_START
columns.description: Represents recommendation scehdule start date

columns.name: SCHEDULE_END
columns.description: Represents recommendation scehdule end date for reconcile

columns.name: SKILL_VARIANT_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Reference to SKILL_VARIANT_CONFIG_ID from WLF_SKILL_VARIANT_CONFIG, applicable for "Gaps"/"skills" recommenders

columns.name: IN_ELASTIC
columns.description: Flag to indicate elastic index is reconciled with latest changes.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for recommendation profile status change

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who created the object.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_COMMENTS
columns.description: Represents the comments for status change on recommendation profile.

columns.name: GAP_RECOM_INCL_UNC_ROLE_SKILLS
columns.description: Specifies if the uncurated skills should be included related to roles (i.e., Job/position profile) for "Gaps in Current Role" and "Gaps in Careers of Interest" recommenders.

columns.name: GAP_RECOM_INCL_UNC_RES_SKILLS
columns.description: Specifies if the uncurated skills should be included related to resources (e.g., learning item, journey, etc.,) for "Gaps in Current Role" and "Gaps in Careers of Interest" recommenders.

columns.name: INCL_CATALOG_SEARCH_RESULTS
columns.description: Specifies whether to use catalog search to suggest resources that fulfill skill gaps.

columns.name: PROCESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: ESS request id that processed the recommendation profile.

columns.name: INCL_RES_WITH_OUTCOME_ONLY
columns.description: Specifies whether to consider only the resources that writes to profile i.e., have an outcome.

columns.name: INCL_REQ_ROLE_SKILL_QUAL_ONLY
columns.description: Specifies whether to consider only skills and qualifications that are marked as required in the role profile.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Captures recommendation profile additional metadata information

columns.name: INCL_RES_MATCH_SKILL_SYNONYM
columns.description: Specifies whether to consider Include resources profiled with skill synonyms
